title: C5: Corundum operator may run relays (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: allowed under ARCHITECTURE §2.4 with distinct keys/principals. Add accepted cost to ARCHITECTURE §9: a party running both a social/identity service and relays can link its own users to the COs whose traffic they use (never content, channel or Space); users and communities may choose other relays.
